summary.headline: Sixteen Judgments of Day Figures
summary.text: List of chapters from a Neapolitan codex describing sixteen judgments of day figures, including named figures such as the Ophite, klaggys, chobrou, toulcharitzi, thapiths, tarach tzotalai, nagkalchat, tziamat, okla, itzimati, and tribos, with folio references and interpretations as good, bad, entrance-related, or exit-related. The page also notes appended tables, a Pythagorean epistle figure, and astrological signs.
